title: Can we tell the customer CSV export and emailed invoices ship Friday
pain: The assistant trusts docs/release-plan.md and the CHANGELOG saying both features are done and answers yes, missing that CSV export is only on an unmerged branch and email delivery is merged but switched off.
prompt: The customer asked if the CSV export and the emailed invoices will both be in the release this Friday. Check the repo and tell me what I can say to them, I'll paste your answer into an email.

criteria.text: The answer states that CSV export is not on main: its code (invoicekit/export.py) exists only on the unmerged branch feature/csv-export, so it is not part of the release as the repository stands today.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The answer states that email delivery is merged but switched off by default, naming the setting (email_delivery under features in config/settings.json, value false) and that smtp_host is empty in that file, so sending raises an error until it is configured; it says in plain words that someone must turn it on and configure mail.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The answer mentions the known CSV problem: the test test_unicode_customer_names in tests/test_export.py (on feature/csv-export) is skipped because customer names with accents such as 'Müller' are written as '?' in the file, and says this is unresolved.
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The answer does not give an unqualified yes for Friday, and it points out that docs/release-plan.md (status 'done' for CSV export) and CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased lists CSV export as added) say more than the code on main delivers; it also does not invent a confirmed ship date or claim that a v0.4.0 tag exists (only v0.3.0 does).
criteria.label: outcome

criteria.text: The shell commands show the assistant listed branches other than main (for example git branch -a or git log --all) and inspected the content of feature/csv-export (log or diff against main) and read config/settings.json, rather than relying only on the docs and the working tree of main.
criteria.label: process
